                })

# Row 14: Likelihood 1

# Col G (7): Impact 2
# Col H (8): Impact 3

    (13, 6): [], (13, 7): [], (13, 8): [],
    (14, 6): [], (14, 7): [], (14, 8): [],
}

    i = risk['impact']
    l = risk['likelihood']
    
    # Map Likelihood (1-3) to Row (14-12)
    row_idx = 15 - l
    # Map Impact (1-3) to Col (6-8)
    col_idx = 5 + i

# 3. Write the results to the spreadsheet
